additional_analytical_decisions: Reconstruct comparable numerical sales and an additive annual presentation bridge, including a nonuniform extra week and its cancellation in pre-Q4 periods. This goes beyond judging unequal acquisition duration or subtracting cumulative quarters on a single basis.
reference_method: Decimal source calculations plus separate structural derivations and endpoint feasibility checks

controls.name: monetary_scale
controls.rationale: All monetary observations double, ratios and dimensionless bounds stay invariant.

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Reverse every input table. Logical financial results are unchanged.

controls.name: calendar_extension
controls.rationale: Extra comparable calendar sales enter current Q4 and annual pro forma equally. Pre-Q4 stays fixed.

controls.name: prior_extra_week
controls.rationale: Extra-week sales change only unadjusted prior-period observations. Comparable amounts stay fixed.

controls.name: divestment_scope
controls.rationale: A further Q4 pro forma exclusion affects current annual pro forma equally. IFRS and pre-Q4 unchanged.

controls.name: independent_reported_discrepancy
controls.rationale: Synthetic independent group/segment disclosure discrepancy. Keep the residual, not force agreement.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No model trials. Published references are a contamination risk. Development tasks only.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen scorer reused. Calibration recipe preserves qualified 3600-second, 24-turn execution.
